script.hook: 10 lakh ki salary par tax zero, phir bhi Papa policy khareedwa rahe the.

scenes.label: HR ka email aur Papa ki salah

visual.prompt: BEHEN in office wear sits at a dining table at night, staring at an email on her laptop, PAPA in a kurta beside her holding an insurance policy brochure, warm lamp light, curious tense mood

scenes.vo: 10 lakh ki salary par tax zero, phir bhi Papa policy khareedwa rahe the. Yeh kahani meri behen ki hai. Pehli badi naukri, pehli badi salary. Aur pehle hi hafte, HR ka email aaya. Sawaal tha, purana regime chahiye ya naya?

visual.prompt: Family gathered around a dining table in the evening, MUMMY in a saree placing cups of chai, PAPA adjusting his glasses and pointing confidently at the laptop, BEHEN listening, cosy middle-class Indian home

scenes.vo: Shaam ko dining table par yeh email poora ghar padh raha tha. Behen ne laptop khola, Mummy chai le aayi. Papa ne chashma lagaya aur seedha bole. Purana regime lo beta, hum hamesha usi mein rahe hain. Wahi safe hai.

visual.prompt: PAPA spreading old FD receipts and insurance papers across the table like trophies, proud expression, BEHEN watching unsure, evening light

scenes.vo: Papa ki dalil simple thi. Purane regime mein tax bachane ke raaste hain. Policy lo, PPF kholo, FD lock karo, tax kam ho jaata hai. Unke liye tax bachana matlab kuch na kuch khareedna. Saalon se har March yahi hota aaya tha.

visual.prompt: BHAI in a hoodie lounging on a sofa scrolling his phone, looking up with a blank face as PAPA turns to question him, comic awkward moment, living room at night

scenes.vo: Bhai hoodie mein sofa par tha, phone haath mein. Bola, Papa, naya regime lo, internet pe sab yahi bol rahe hain. Papa ne poochha, kyun? Bhai ke paas jawab nahi tha. Bas subah dekhi ek reel yaad thi.

visual.prompt: BEHEN sitting between PAPA holding old papers and BHAI holding a glowing phone, both leaning toward her, she looks confused and pressured, dramatic split lighting

scenes.vo: Aur yahin asli dikkat hai. Ek taraf aadat hai, doosri taraf reel. Beech mein woh insaan hai jiski salary kat-ti hai. Usse koi hisaab karke nahi dikhata. Toh aaj hum hisaab karenge, bilkul dining table wala, seedha.

visual.prompt: SG, early forties with a beard and striped shirt, sitting at the head of the dining table with a notepad, calm smile, family looking at him, warm night light

scenes.vo: Aaj ke sawaal yeh hain. Kya naya regime sabke liye sasta hai? Kya 80C ab bhi kaam ka hai, ya bas aadat hai? Aur HRA yaani kiraaye par tax chhoot, kab sach mein kaam aati hai? Jawab isi ghar ki kahani se.

visual.prompt: SG holding two thick rulebooks, one old and worn with many bookmarks, one new and slim, balancing them like a scale, explaining gesture, plain warm background

scenes.vo: Pehle ek baat saaf kar dein. Regime yaani tax ka rulebook. Sarkar ne dono rulebook aapke saamne rakh diye hain. Purane mein rate zyada, par chhoot bahut. Naye mein rate kam, par chhoot gini-chuni. Kuch na bolo, toh naya apne aap lagta hai.

scenes.label: Naya regime: zero tax ka raaz

visual.prompt: SG and BEHEN leaning over a printed salary slip under a table lamp, SG tracing a line with a pen, BEHEN focused, late night quiet room

scenes.vo: Raat ko maine behen ke saath uski salary slip kholi. Sabse upar gross salary, yaani katne se pehle ki poori kamai. Neeche PF aur ek line, TDS. TDS yaani company har mahine aapka tax pehle hi kaat leti hai.

visual.prompt: BEHEN surprised as SG slides a chunk of her salary slip aside with a pen, an empty space where receipts usually go, light of realisation on her face

scenes.vo: Naye regime mein salaried logon ko seedha 75,000 ki chhoot milti hai. Isse standard deduction kehte hain. Koi policy nahi, koi receipt nahi, koi proof nahi. Bas aap naukri karte ho, aur itna hissa tax se bahar.

visual.prompt: A stack of rupee notes on a table with a small portion moved aside by a hand, the remaining stack under a spotlight, simple dramatic still life

scenes.vo: Matlab salary mein se pehle yeh hissa nikal jaata hai. Jo bachta hai, usse taxable income kehte hain. Taxable income yaani woh kamai jis par sach mein tax lagta hai. Ab asli twist aata hai.

visual.prompt: A tax bill on a table being stamped cancelled by an official hand, BEHEN in the background with wide eyes and a slow smile, bright clean light

scenes.vo: Naye regime mein 12 lakh tak ki taxable income par tax zero hai. Yeh Section 87A ke rebate se hota hai. Rebate yaani tax banta toh hai, par sarkar use poora maaf kar deti hai.

visual.prompt: PAPA taking off his glasses and leaning close to the laptop screen in disbelief, BEHEN beside him grinning, MUMMY peeking over his shoulder, night

scenes.vo: Behen ki taxable income is limit se kaafi neeche thi. Matlab naye regime mein uska income tax, zero. Na policy, na lock-in, na March ki bhaag-daud. Papa ne chashma utaara aur phir se screen dekhi.

visual.prompt: SG drawing two building blocks on a notepad and stacking them into a protective wall around a small house, BEHEN nodding, warm desk light

scenes.vo: Salaried ke liye yeh faayda aur bada ho jaata hai. Pehle 75,000 ki chhoot, phir 12 lakh tak rebate. Dono milkar ek achhi khaasi salary ko tax se bahar rakh dete hain. Bahut log yeh jod kar dekhte hi nahi.

visual.prompt: SG standing at a fork in a road at dusk, one path wide and smooth, the other winding with signposts, thoughtful expression

scenes.vo: Toh kya naya regime sabke liye sasta hai? Nahi, sabke liye nahi. Jinki salary is range mein hai, unke liye aksar haan. Par jinki kamai zyada hai, aur kharche chhoot wale hain, unki kahani alag ho sakti hai.

visual.prompt: BHAI looking at a stock chart on his phone while SG gently taps his shoulder with a cautious look, living room at night

scenes.vo: Ek baat aur dhyaan rakhna. Yeh rebate salary jaisi normal income par hai. Share bechkar kamaya munafa, yaani capital gains, uske alag niyam hain. Agar aap trading bhi karte ho, poora hisaab kisi CA se zaroor karwa lena.

scenes.label: 80C ab kaam ka hai ya nahi?

visual.prompt: PAPA holding a bundle of old insurance and PPF passbooks to his chest, worried face, SG sitting opposite him with an understanding look, dim evening light

scenes.vo: Ab Papa ka sawaal. Beta, toh meri LIC aur PPF sab bekaar? Yahan samajhna zaroori hai. 80C yaani purane regime ka woh section, jahan kuch investments par chhoot milti hai. Naye regime mein yeh chhoot milti hi nahi.

visual.prompt: A wooden box on a table being filled with a PPF passbook, an insurance policy and fund papers, the lid barely closing, PAPA watching proudly

scenes.vo: Purane regime mein 80C ki limit 1.5 lakh hai. PPF, EPF, life insurance premium, tax saving fund, sab milakar itne tak. Yeh amount taxable income se ghat jaata hai. Sunne mein bahut bada lagta hai.

visual.prompt: SG pointing at the PF line on BEHEN's salary slip while PAPA leans in with raised eyebrows, small moment of discovery, table lamp light

scenes.vo: Par ek cheez Papa ne kabhi nahi gini. Behen ki salary se EPF pehle hi kat raha hai. EPF yaani provident fund, jo aap aur company har mahine daalte ho. Woh bhi 80C mein ginta hai. Limit ka hissa pehle se bhara hai.

visual.prompt: BEHEN signing a thick insurance form at a crowded office desk in March, an agent smiling across the table, her face tired and unsure, harsh fluorescent light

scenes.vo: Ab socho behen ne Papa ki baat maan li. Purana regime liya, aur March mein ek insurance policy le li. Saalon tak premium bharna, lock-in, aur return ka pata nahi. Sirf isliye kyunki tax bachana tha.

visual.prompt: A locked steel cash box with a heavy chain on a table, BEHEN's hand resting on it, her face realising the mistake, cold blue light

scenes.vo: Par naye regime mein uska tax pehle se zero tha. Jis tax ko bachane ke liye policy li, woh tax tha hi nahi. Policy ka faayda tax mein nahi mila. Bas paisa saalon ke liye bandh ho gaya. Yahi woh trap hai.

visual.prompt: PAPA calmly handing BEHEN a new PPF passbook at a bank counter, BANK UNCLE smiling behind the glass, relaxed daytime mood

scenes.vo: Iska matlab yeh nahi ki PPF bura hai. PPF par abhi lagbhag 7.1 percent saalana byaaj hai. Lambi bachat ke liye log ise pasand karte hain. Bas ab PPF bachat ke liye kholo, tax ke darr se nahi.

visual.prompt: SG at the dining table with two small piles of papers, moving one aside decisively, clear calm explaining expression

scenes.vo: Toh 80C ab kaam ka hai ya nahi? Purane regime mein ho, toh haan, bahut kaam ka. Naye regime mein ho, toh tax ke liye bilkul nahi. Pehle regime chuno, phir socho ki 80C ki zaroorat hai bhi.

visual.prompt: PAPA sitting quietly with an old photo album of FD receipts, SG with a hand on his shoulder, tender emotional moment, soft night light

scenes.vo: Papa ne thodi der chup rehkar kaha, matlab maine itne saal galat kiya? Maine kaha, nahi Papa. Aapke zamaane mein naya regime tha hi nahi. Tab wahi sahi tha. Bas rules badal gaye, aur hum aadat nahi badle.

scenes.label: HRA aur deductions: purana kab jeetta hai

visual.prompt: A confident young woman colleague in office wear at a high-rise office window overlooking a big city, holding a rent agreement and a health insurance card, afternoon light

scenes.vo: Ab kahani ka doosra pehlu. Har kisi ke liye naya regime nahi jeetta. Behen ki ek colleague ko dekho. Woh bade sheher mein kiraaye par rehti hai. Mummy-Papa ka health insurance bharti hai. Aur salary kaafi upar hai.

visual.prompt: The colleague handing rent to a landlord at the door of a small city apartment, keys and a rent receipt in hand, evening

scenes.vo: Pehle HRA samjho. HRA yaani House Rent Allowance, jo company kiraaye ke liye deti hai. Purane regime mein iska bada hissa tax se bahar ho sakta hai, agar aap sach mein kiraaya dete ho. Naye regime mein yeh chhoot nahi.

visual.prompt: A neat folder of rent receipts being filed in a drawer by the colleague, organised desk, calm focused face, night lamp

scenes.vo: Isliye rent receipt aur landlord ki details sambhaal kar rakho. Aur jo log apne ghar mein rehte hain, unke liye HRA chhoot ka sawaal hi nahi. Wahan HRA bas salary ka taxable hissa ban jaata hai.

visual.prompt: A middle-aged man receiving house keys at a bank counter from BANK UNCLE, loan papers on the counter, hopeful expression, daytime

scenes.vo: Ab home loan. Purane regime mein apne ghar ke loan ke byaaj par bhi chhoot milti hai. Byaaj yaani loan ka woh hissa jo bank ka munafa hai. Health insurance ka premium bhi purane regime mein income se ghatta hai.

visual.prompt: The colleague at a desk adding up a long column on paper with a calculator, pile of receipts beside her, determined look, late evening

scenes.vo: Colleague ne sab joda. Kiraaye ki chhoot, 80C, health insurance. Deductions yaani woh kharche jo taxable income se ghata diye jaate hain. Uski deductions bahut badi ban gayi. Jitni badi deductions, utna purana regime aakarshak.

visual.prompt: A staircase drawn as rising steps with the colleague climbing toward the top step, the steps getting steeper, dramatic upward perspective

scenes.vo: Uski salary itni upar hai ki naye regime mein unche slab tak jaati hai. Slab yaani income ke tukde, har tukde par alag rate. Naye regime ka sabse ooncha slab 30 percent hai, 24 lakh ke upar.

visual.prompt: The colleague smiling with relief as she compares two sheets of paper side by side, one clearly lighter, soft morning light at her desk

scenes.vo: Aisi kamai par zero tax wala rebate kaam nahi aata. Ab har rupaye ki chhoot asli paisa bachati hai. Isliye purane regime ki badi deductions sach mein farq daal sakti hain. Uske case mein purana regime jeet bhi sakta hai.

visual.prompt: SG and BEHEN side by side looking at a calculator page on a laptop, both pointing at the screen, satisfied expressions, bright room

scenes.vo: Toh formula simple hai. Dono regime mein tax nikaalo, jo kam aaye, woh chuno. Income tax ki website par calculator hai. Wahan dono hisaab saath mein dikh jaate hain. Andaaza mat lagao, number dekho.

scenes.label: Galti, switch aur aapka faisla

visual.prompt: SG at a chapter turn standing between a cartoon of PAPA clutching old files and BHAI staring at his phone, SG shrugging with a knowing smile

scenes.vo: Ab woh galti jo sabse zyada log karte hain. Regime ko aadat se chunte hain, hisaab se nahi. Kuch Papa ki tarah purane se chipke rehte hain. Kuch Bhai ki tarah reel dekhkar naya le lete hain. Dono mein hisaab gayab hai.

visual.prompt: A long hurried queue of tired office workers outside an insurance office at the end of March, papers in hand, rushed chaotic mood

scenes.vo: Doosri galti, March ki bhaag-daud. Saal bhar kuch nahi, aur aakhri hafte mein koi bhi policy. Sirf tax bachane ke liye. Product ko uske kaam ke liye lo, tax ke liye nahi. Chhoot bonus ho sakti hai, wajah nahi.

visual.prompt: BEHEN at her office desk filling an online HR form on a computer, a colleague walking past with coffee, morning office light

scenes.vo: Ab switch kaise karte hain. Salaried ko saal ki shuruaat mein HR ko regime batana hota hai. Usi hisaab se har mahine TDS katta hai. Aap kuch nahi batate, toh company naya regime maan leti hai, kyunki wahi default hai.

visual.prompt: BEHEN at home filing a return on her laptop late at night, relieved smile, cup of chai beside her, calm lamp light

scenes.vo: Achhi khabar yeh hai. Salaried log return file karte waqt bhi regime badal sakte hain. Return yaani ITR, saal ke end mein sarkar ko diya gaya poora hisaab. HR ko galat bata diya, toh bhi faisla return mein ho sakta hai, deadline ke andar.

visual.prompt: SHOPKEEPER at his kirana counter looking at a tax form with a puzzled frown, shelves of goods behind him, afternoon light

scenes.vo: Bas yeh dhyaan rakhna. Jinki business income hai, unke liye switch itna aasaan nahi. Unke liye wapas aane ke mauke bahut kam hain. Agar aapki dukaan ya practice hai, regime badalne se pehle kisi jaankar se zaroor poochho.

visual.prompt: PAPA closing a drawer with the unsigned insurance form inside, BEHEN smiling at her laptop, MUMMY bringing chai, peaceful happy family moment at night

scenes.vo: Behen ne us raat HR ko reply kiya, naya regime. Papa ne hisaab dekhkar haan kahi. Policy ka form waapas drawer mein chala gaya. PPF ab bhi khulegi, par bachat ke liye. Yeh investment advice nahi hai. Apna hisaab khud karo.

visual.prompt: SG sitting at the dining table holding up a salary slip toward the viewer, friendly inviting smile, warm evening light

scenes.vo: Toh aapka sawaal. Aap abhi kaun se regime mein ho, purana ya naya? Comments mein bas purana ya naya likho. Aur agar pata hi nahi, toh apni salary slip dekho. Wahi pehla kadam hai.

visual.prompt: BHAI in a hoodie excitedly showing his phone with a stock chart to SG at the dining table, SG raising an eyebrow with a teasing smile, night

scenes.vo: Agli baar woh sawaal jo har ghar mein hota hai. Share bechne par tax kab lagta hai, aur kab nahi? Capital gains ki poori kahani, isi dining table par. Tab tak, apna hisaab khud karna seekho.
